cards.example_en: The bitter medicine worked, though he hated the taste.
cards.example_zh: 这种苦药起了作用，尽管他讨厌那个味道。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：性格；人物
cards.example_en: His honest character won the trust of his friends.
cards.example_zh: 他诚实的性格赢得了朋友们的信任。

cards.example_en: Dinner was fish and rice, with watermelon for anyone still hungry.
cards.example_zh: 晚餐是鱼和米饭，没吃饱的人还有西瓜。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：提供商
cards.example_en: Our phone provider repaired the home line before class.
cards.example_zh: 我们的电话提供商在上课前修好了家里的线路。

cards.example_en: Fish and rice made a hot supper after swimming.
cards.example_zh: 游完泳以后，晚饭是热乎的鱼和米饭。

cards.example_en: The winner of the race received a gold medal.
cards.example_zh: 赛跑的胜者得到了一枚金牌。

cards.example_en: The captain read a short statement before the match.
cards.example_zh: 队长在比赛前读了一则简短的陈述。

cards.example_en: This illustration shows how blood moves through the heart.
cards.example_zh: 这幅插图展示血液怎样流过心脏。

cards.example_en: An investigation began after money went missing from the office.
cards.example_zh: 办公室的钱不见了之后，调查就开始了。

cards.example_en: The aid organisation brought clean water to the flooded streets.
cards.example_zh: 援助组织给被淹的街道送来了干净的水。

cards.example_en: A high proportion of students cycle to school here.
cards.example_zh: 在这里，骑自行车上学的学生比例很高。

cards.example_en: She put the accent on the wrong syllable and we laughed.
cards.example_zh: 她把重音放错了音节，惹得我们笑了起来。

cards.example_en: That farm grows rice on about one acre of land.
cards.example_zh: 那个农场大约用一英亩地种水稻。

cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：成年人
cards.example_en: An adult must sit with the young child.
cards.example_zh: 必须有一名成人和小孩坐在一起。

cards.example_en: Exam anxiety kept her awake the night before history.
cards.example_zh: 历史考试的前一天夜里，她焦虑得睡不着。
